text: On an overnight train to Pittsburgh, the young man Martin sedates a woman with a syringe, slices her arm with a razor and [drinks her blood|wants|feeding on the living]. In Braddock his elderly cousin Cuda calls him Nosferatu, hangs garlic and [a crucifix|images|holy and occult objects] that Martin mocks, and vows to stake him if he kills. Delivering groceries, haunted by [monochrome visions that may be memories or fantasies|rules|reality comes apart], [the troubled young man|who_suffers|monsters who suffer] confides in a radio disc jockey and is drawn to Abby Santini, a depressed housewife.
